limitations: A 200 status and .XLSX/.PDF URL did not return the requested data; returned HTML is treated as an access/interstitial failure, not as evidence.

RBI FAQ states retail NCB uses weighted-average successful competitive price/yield and explains uniform-price versus multiple-price auction allocation. Table 218 does not include auction method or weighted-average price, so equality with cutoff is unqualified row by row.
A sample spanning 50 auctions does not establish a complete multi-year rolling T-bill total-return series; no investor-specific bid/allotment/funding/fees/tax path is reconstructed.
Even a qualified cutoff/NCB acquisition price alone would omit investment cash timing, failed/partial allotment, holding to maturity, reinvestment, idle cash, service charges, eligibility and tax.
This source does not qualify dated GoI bond secondary-market total-return or reinvested coupon return.
lawful_next_route: Acquire Table 218 using the official RBI page/download or DBIE in a normally supported access path, and preserve original bytes/hash and source metadata.
For each auction, obtain an official auction notification/result identifying uniform or multiple pricing and the NCB weighted-average price; retain absent rows as blocked.
Construct rolling holdings only from dated auction, allotment, settlement, maturity/redemption and reinvestment cashflows; include lawful retail route charges and taxes.

For dated bonds, use public first-party price/cashflow data or a separately authorized private data license. CCIL public MTM may be used only within its published terms; distinguish trade prices from model marks and do not redistribute restricted data.

retail_allocation_rule.rbi_faq_rule: Retail NCB allotment uses weighted-average price/yield of successful competitive bids.
retail_allocation_rule.uniform_price_condition: For a uniform-price auction, successful competitive bids are allotted at the cutoff; cutoff may equal the NCB weighted average.
retail_allocation_rule.multiple_price_condition: For a multiple-price auction, accepted competitive bidders pay their respective bids; the NCB weighted average need not equal cutoff.
retail_allocation_rule.conclusion: Do not assume cutoff equals retail NCB price for any Table 218 row without row-level auction-method evidence.
